pr_title: Ensure ESPHome dashboard connection recovers if its down when core starts
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

If the dashboard was down (or not started yet) at startup, we would not try again later to connect until core was restarted.

fixes #96447

Unfortunately it means we end up reloading all the entries when it does come back online later but thats still better than being offline forever.  Ideally supervisor would start the dashboard before core so this condition doesn't ever happen but that is outside the scope of core.

### The problem

Hi 

Recently this [issue](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/88155) has returned when I restart HAOS, where a restart of Core brings the entities back again.

Here some logs after restarting HAOS.

I don't often restart the entire system, but it may have started since core 2023.7 but that is just my guess.

```

Source: components/esphome/dashboard.py:37
Integration: ESPHome (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 12:58:51 PM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 12:58:51 PM

Dashboard unavailable; skipping setup: Cannot connect to host 127.0.0.1:63803 ssl:default [Connect call failed ('127.0.0.1', 63803)]
```
